group.title: Correcting a product launch announcement
group.passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — PRODUCT BRIEF: AEROLITE DESK FAN
Launch date: November 4
Retail price: $58
Colours: white and charcoal
The AeroLite has three speeds and a rechargeable battery providing up to eight hours of operation at the lowest speed. A charging cable is included; a wall adapter is sold separately. The fan is intended for indoor use. The removable front grille can be washed after detaching it from the motor housing. The motor housing must never be immersed in water.
Launch promotion: orders placed on the company website from November 4 through November 10 receive free standard shipping. This offer does not apply to purchases through other retailers.

DOCUMENT 2 — DRAFT NEWSLETTER
Subject: Stay cool anywhere with AeroLite!
Our new $58 desk fan arrives November 4 in white and charcoal. Enjoy eight hours of battery life at any speed, then recharge using the included wall adapter. Take it to the office or the beach! For effortless cleaning, simply place the entire fan in water. Buy from any retailer during launch week and shipping is on us.

DOCUMENT 3 — EMAIL
From: Product Manager Sonia Ellis
To: Marketing Editor Ben Ross
Subject: Please hold the AeroLite newsletter
Ben, the colours, price, and release date are correct, but several other claims in the draft conflict with the approved brief. Please correct the battery description, package contents, intended use, cleaning instructions, and shipping promotion. The cleaning statement is especially important: it could lead customers to damage the product. Do not send the newsletter until I have approved the revised version. We can keep the scheduled send date if you return the corrected draft by 2 p.m. today.

售價 $58 的新桌扇十一月四日推出，白色及炭灰色。任一風速都享八小時續航，再用內附插座式電源轉接器充電。帶去辦公室或海灘吧！清潔只要把整台放入水中。上市週向任何零售商購買都由我們付運費。

顏色、價格和上市日期正確，但其他幾項敘述與核准簡介不符。請修正電池描述、包裝內容、使用場所、清潔方式及運費優惠。清潔敘述尤其重要，可能讓顧客損壞產品。我核准新版前不要寄送。若今天最遲於下午兩點交回修訂稿，就可以維持預定寄送日期。
